description: Net Pulse's complete IPC surface. Every command the frontend can invoke is named explicitly here — nothing else is reachable, mirroring the old Electron contextBridge allowlist (see preload.js in the legacy electron/ app) but enforced by Tauri's own permission system instead of a hand-written bridge object. Almost no built-in Tauri capabilities are granted — deliberate exceptions are tauri-plugin-dialog's save/open permissions (native Save As / Open dialogs for the .npulse target-list format), scoped to exactly those two operations; the updater/process plugins (check-for-updates + relaunch after install); core:event's listen permission (ping's streaming output — np-ping-line/np-ping-done — is delivered via Tauri's event system, which needs this even though the events themselves are app-defined, not a built-in Tauri feature); and core:app's version-read permission (the About box shows the real bundled version instead of a hand-typed string that could drift out of sync at release time). Every network operation still goes through the app's own commands below, not a generic plugin.
